serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Securin Platform is an AI-native Preemptive Exposure
Management Platform. It shows which risks are exploitable,
what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do. Through
Offensive Exposure Validation, Securin uses attacker
techniques not scanner signatures to validate exploitability,
prioritize remediation, and prove fixes worked. It unifies
external attack surface discovery, vulnerability and threat
intelligence, risk-based prioritization, and validation into one
continuous CTEM workflow: Discover, Validate, Prioritize,
Mobilize.

certified.usageAndConfiguration:
Resource is deployed and configured according to FedRAMP specifications
and related guidance.
certified.justificationForUse:
AWS US East/West is a FedRAMP Certified IaaS/PaaS provider authorized
above the Class A level, which allows Securin to inherit physical,
environmental, hypervisor, network backbone and media protection controls
from a provider already assessed against FedRAMP requirements. Building
on AWS lets the offering rely on a mature shared responsibility model, FIPS
140 validated endpoints and native security tooling instead of operating
data centers or custom infrastructure, which reduces the attack surface and
the scope of controls [Company] must implement directly. Only FedRAMP
in scope AWS services are used, and all federal customer data remains
within the AWS US East/West authorization boundary.
certified.mitigationMeasures:
Federal customer data is logically separated per tenant at the application
and database layers and never leaves the AWS US regions. Encryption at
rest and in transit with customer managed KMS keys, key rotation and
restricted key policies limits exposure if any single component is
compromised. Security groups, NACLs and private subnets enforce
network segmentation; GuardDuty, Security Hub and CloudWatch alarms
provide continuous detection with alerts routed to the on-call security team.
Vulnerability scanning of images and hosts runs on every build and on a
recurring schedule, with remediation tracked against FedRAMP timelines.
AWS account access is reviewed continuously, privileged actions are
logged and immutable logs are retained for one year. Automated backups
and tested restore procedures protect integrity and availability.
certified.compensatingControls:
An independent vulnerability and exposure management process ([Securin
Platform]) that prioritizes findings across the AWS estate and tracks
remediation SLAs; a documented incident response plan with US based
personnel and defined US CERT reporting procedures; change
management requiring peer review and automated policy checks before
deployment; and periodic third-party penetration testing of the application
layer in addition to AWS shared responsibility coverage. Only services
listed as in scope on the AWS FedRAMP services page are used; any new
service is reviewed and approved by security before adoption.
certified.securityCategory:
Low (FIPS 199: Confidentiality Low, Integrity Low, Availability Low),
consistent with FedRAMP Class A.
